class.name: OcgMessageProgressrange
class.brief_description: Auxiliary class representing a part of the global progress scale allocated by a step of the progress scope, see Message_ProgressScope::Next().
class.description: ! Auxiliary class representing a part of the global progress scale allocated by ! a step of the progress scope, see Message_ProgressScope::Next(). ! ! A range object takes responsibility of advancing the progress by the size of ! allocated step, which is then performed depending on how it is used: ! ! - If Message_ProgressScope object is created using this range as argument, then ! this respondibility is taken over by that scope. ! ! - Otherwise, a range advances progress directly upon destruction. ! ! A range object can be copied, the responsibility for progress advancement is ! then taken by the copy. ! The same range object may be used (either copied or used to create scope) only once. ! Any consequent attempts to use range will give no result on the progress; ! in debug mode, an assert message will be generated. ! ! @sa Message_ProgressScope for more details

method.name: UserBreak
method.description: Returns true if ProgressIndicator signals UserBreak

method.name: More
method.description: Returns false if ProgressIndicator signals UserBreak

method.name: IsActive
method.description: Returns true if this progress range is attached to some indicator.

method.name: Close
method.description: Closes the current range and advances indicator
